snippet.title: Fractured Worlds Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re excited to announce that Fractured Worlds launches in full on August 26 on PC (EGS/Steam), Playstation 5 and Nintendo Switch!

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017408
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fractured-worlds-switch/
